verses.ar: اِنَّا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنَا نُوۡحًا اِلٰي قَوۡمِهٖ٘ اَنۡ اَنۡذِرۡ قَوۡمَكَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِ اَنۡ يَّاۡتِيَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ اَلِيۡمٌ
verses.en: We sent NūH to his people (and said to him): “Warn your people before a painful punishment comes to them.”

verses.ar: قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اِنِّيۡ لَكُمۡ نَذِيۡرٌ مُّبِيۡنٌۙ‏
verses.en: He said, “O my people, I openly warn you

verses.ar: اَنِ اعۡبُدُوا اللّٰهَ وَاتَّقُوۡهُ وَاَطِيۡعُوۡنِۙ‏
verses.en: that you must worship Allah, and fear Him, and obey me,

verses.ar: يَغۡفِرۡ لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ ذُنُوۡبِكُمۡ وَيُؤَخِّرۡكُمۡ اِلٰ٘ي اَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّيؕ اِنَّ اَجَلَ اللّٰهِ اِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُۘ لَوۡ كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
verses.en: and Allah will forgive you your sins, and will respite you to an appointed term. Indeed when Allah’s term comes, it is not deferred, if you only know!”

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّيۡ دَعَوۡتُ قَوۡمِيۡ لَيۡلًا وَّنَهَارًاۙ‏
verses.en: He said, “My Lord, I have called my people night and day,

verses.ar: فَلَمۡ يَزِدۡهُمۡ دُعَآءِيۡ٘ اِلَّا فِرَارًا
verses.en: but my call added only to their flight (from the truth).

verses.ar: وَاِنِّيۡ كُلَّمَا دَعَوۡتُهُمۡ لِتَغۡفِرَ لَهُمۡ جَعَلُوۡ٘ا اَصَابِعَهُمۡ فِيۡ٘ اٰذَانِهِمۡ وَاسۡتَغۡشَوۡا ثِيَابَهُمۡ وَاَصَرُّوۡا وَاسۡتَكۡبَرُوا اسۡتِكۡبَارًاۚ‏
verses.en: Whenever I called them, so that You might forgive them, they put their fingers into their ears, and wrapped their clothes around themselves, and grew obstinate, and waxed proud in extreme arrogance.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ اِنِّيۡ دَعَوۡتُهُمۡ جِهَارًاۙ‏
verses.en: Then I called them loudly,

verses.ar: ثُمَّ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَعۡلَنۡتُ لَهُمۡ وَاَسۡرَرۡتُ لَهُمۡ اِسۡرَارًاۙ‏
verses.en: and then I spoke to them in public and spoke to them in private.

verses.ar: فَقُلۡتُ اسۡتَغۡفِرُوۡا رَبَّكُمۡࣞ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ غَفَّارًاۙ‏
verses.en: So I said, ‘Pray to your Lord for your forgiveness,- Indeed He is Very-Forgiving, -

verses.ar: يُّرۡسِلِ السَّمَآءَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ مِّدۡرَارًاۙ‏
verses.en: and He will cause the heavens to rain upon you in abundance,

verses.ar: وَّيُمۡدِدۡكُمۡ بِاَمۡوَالٍ وَّبَنِيۡنَ وَيَجۡعَلۡ لَّكُمۡ جَنّٰتٍ وَّيَجۡعَلۡ لَّكُمۡ اَنۡهٰرًاؕ‏
verses.en: and will help you with riches and sons, and will cause gardens to grow for you, and cause rivers to flow for you.

verses.ar: مَا لَكُمۡ لَا تَرۡجُوۡنَ لِلّٰهِ وَقَارًاۚ‏
verses.en: What has happened to you that you do not appreciate the Majesty of Allah,

verses.ar: وَقَدۡ خَلَقَكُمۡ اَطۡوَارًا
verses.en: while He has created you in different phases?

verses.ar: اَلَمۡ تَرَوۡا كَيۡفَ خَلَقَ اللّٰهُ سَبۡعَ سَمٰوٰتٍ طِبَاقًاۙ‏
verses.en: Did you not see how Allah has created seven heavens one upon another,

verses.ar: وَّجَعَلَ الۡقَمَرَ فِيۡهِنَّ نُوۡرًا وَّجَعَلَ الشَّمۡسَ سِرَاجًا
verses.en: and has made the moon a light therein, and made the sun a lamp?

verses.ar: وَاللّٰهُ اَنۭۡ بَتَكُمۡ مِّنَ الۡاَرۡضِ نَبَاتًاۙ‏
verses.en: And Allah has caused you to grow well out of the earth,

verses.ar: ثُمَّ يُعِيۡدُكُمۡ فِيۡهَا وَيُخۡرِجُكُمۡ اِخۡرَاجًا
verses.en: then He will send you back into it, and will bring you forth once again.

verses.ar: وَاللّٰهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الۡاَرۡضَ بِسَاطًاۙ‏
verses.en: And Allah has made the earth a spread for you,

verses.ar: لِّتَسۡلُكُوۡا مِنۡهَا سُبُلًا فِجَاجًاࣖ‏
verses.en: so that you may go about its broad ways.’”

verses.ar: قَالَ نُوۡحٌ رَّبِّ اِنَّهُمۡ عَصَوۡنِيۡ وَاتَّبَعُوۡا مَنۡ لَّمۡ يَزِدۡهُ مَالُهٗ وَوَلَدُهٗ٘ اِلَّا خَسَارًاۚ‏
verses.en: And said NūH, “My Lord, they disobeyed me, and followed him whose wealth and children added nothing to him but loss,

verses.ar: وَمَكَرُوۡا مَكۡرًا كُبَّارًاۚ‏
verses.en: and they devised a mighty plot,

verses.ar: وَقَالُوۡا لَا تَذَرُنَّ اٰلِهَتَكُمۡ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَّلَا سُوَاعًا ࣢ۙ وَّلَا يَغُوۡثَ وَيَعُوۡقَ وَنَسۡرًاۚ‏
verses.en: and said (to their people), “Never forsake your gods, and never forsake Wadd, nor Suwā‘, nor Yaghūth and Ya‘ūq and Nasr.

verses.ar: وَقَدۡ اَضَلُّوۡا كَثِيۡرًا ࣢ۚ وَلَا تَزِدِ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ اِلَّا ضَلٰلًا
verses.en: And they have led many astray. And (O my Lord,) let not the wrongdoers progress in anything but deviation from the right path.”

verses.ar: مِمَّا خَطِيۡٓـٰٔتِهِمۡ اُغۡرِقُوۡا فَاُدۡخِلُوۡا نَارًا ࣢ۙ فَلَمۡ يَجِدُوۡا لَهُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ اَنۡصَارًا
verses.en: Because of their sins they were drowned, and then admitted into the Fire. So they found no helpers for them besides Allah.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ نُوۡحٌ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرۡ عَلَي الۡاَرۡضِ مِنَ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ دَيَّارًا
verses.en: And said NūH, “My Lord, do not leave on earth even a single inhabitant (surviving) out of the disbelievers.

verses.ar: اِنَّكَ اِنۡ تَذَرۡهُمۡ يُضِلُّوۡا عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوۡ٘ا اِلَّا فَاجِرًا كَفَّارًا
verses.en: If You leave them (surviving), they will lead Your servants astray, and will beget none but a sinful disbeliever.

verses.ar: رَبِّ اغۡفِرۡ لِيۡ وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَنۡ دَخَلَ بَيۡتِيَ مُؤۡمِنًا وَّلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ وَالۡمُؤۡمِنٰتِؕ وَلَا تَزِدِ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ اِلَّا تَبَارًاࣖ‏
verses.en: My Lord, grant pardon to me, and to my parents, and to everyone who enters my home as a believer, and to all the believing men and believing women, and do not increase the wrongdoers but in ruin.
